# Source Code

#### Course: Learn Recursion with Python

## Source Code

```python
1def fib(n):
2
3    # base case 
4    # if number is 1 and 0 return 1 and 0
5    if n == 1 or n == 0:
6        return n
7
8    # least amount of work to perform in each recursive call
9    return fib(n - 1) + fib(n - 2)
10
11result = fib(4)
12print(result)
```

Output

```text
3
```

For the sake of simplicity, we are only printing the value at the n index or the (n + 1)th position of the series.

Since n == 4, the above output gives the value of the Fibonacci series at the fifth position.
